talking_points: Big Tech's AI spending spree is starting to eat into the cash flow of even the biggest hyperscalers, with only Microsoft still free cash flow positive this quarter.
Google lost roughly $500 billion in market value as its own AI search tools cannibalise the ad revenue that funds its AI bets, a neat irony worth raising in any AI strategy conversation.
Canadian banks blocking AI agents from touching customer accounts shows that 'agentic AI' still has a trust problem long before it has a technical one.
